screeningSummary: Longtime listener pitches himself as the show's official caller-grader with scorecards
arcNotes: Opinion/meta caller - no sighting, all ego (Fake tell: demands airtime for grading others). Vern concedes adjective-watching is real tradecraft, refuses the segment, then flips it: grade live, once, when someone earns it. Comedic
